title: xtralab Terminals panel
description: The left-sidebar panel that lists running terminal sessions.

showAgentActivity.title: Show agent activity under each terminal
showAgentActivity.description: When true, every terminal running a coding agent shows a smaller line below its title with the agent's latest line of output, so you can see what a backgrounded agent is doing without switching to it. Turn this off to list terminals by title alone.

showExternalAgents.title: Show agents running outside JupyterLab
showExternalAgents.description: When true, the panel has an External agents section listing the coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, pi) started in other terminals for this folder, with their conversation, a way to send them a prompt and, where the agent allows it, a terminal that attaches to them.
